title: Implement Request Logging with Error Handling
description: This feature adds robust request logging to yantraverse, allowing for better error tracking and debugging, while also handling edge cases and incorporating logging for error handling. It will provide valuable insights into application performance and help identify potential issues. This will improve the overall reliability and maintainability of the framework
testCases: Test request logging for successful requests
Test request logging for failed requests with error handling
acceptance: The feature is accepted when request logs are correctly generated for both successful and failed requests, and error handling is properly implemented
reason: Implementing request logging with error handling will significantly improve the framework's ability to diagnose and fix issues, making it more attractive to developers and increasing its overall value proposition
